traces for recommendationservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 1.0->1.02ms (1.02x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 3.85->204.07ms (53.01x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Own span self-time is essentially unchanged (1.0->1.02ms) while inbound caller-observed latency rose 3.85->204.07ms (E3). The added time is outside the service's processing. Only latency metrics deviated, with no resource-metric shifts (E2).

Frontend latency deviation (z=69, 517%) is far smaller than recommendationservice's (z=893, 4467%) (E1). Caller-observed delay is concentrated on calls into recommendationservice (E3), so frontend is a downstream symptom.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the injected network delay on the recommendationservice pod's network interface (e.g. delete the tc netem qdisc or the chaos experiment). Then confirm that inbound p50 latency returns to about 4ms and frontend latency recovers.
